meta.name: datalad
meta.description: Retrieve, version, and publish scientific datasets with DataLad and git-annex, and capture computational provenance with datalad run, rerun, and containers-run. Use when cloning or fetching data from OpenNeuro, DANDI, datasets.datalad.org, or any DataLad dataset; when a file in a dataset reads as a broken symlink or a small pointer instead of real data; when an analysis needs a machine-readable record of how each output was produced so it can be re-executed; or when publishing a dataset to siblings such as a GitHub repository plus a storage remote. Also use to decide between DataLad and plain Git for a data-carrying repository.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据连同它的生成过程一起存档,随时取回并重跑分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有体积大、常更新的科研数据,还想让别人能一键复现你的分析
copy.tagline_en: Version data with how it was made, so any analysis can be re-fetched and re-run
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hold large, often-updated research data and want others to reproduce your analysis

howto.what: 它会用 DataLad 和 git-annex 管理科学数据集：克隆 OpenNeuro、DANDI 等数据集并取回真实文件内容，用 datalad run/rerun 记录并重放分析过程，把数据集发布到 Git 与存储远端。
howto.when: 当你克隆或取用 OpenNeuro、DANDI 等 DataLad 数据集时，数据集里的文件读出来是坏软链或几百字节的指针文件时，或分析需要可重跑的产生记录时。

say.text: 克隆 ds000001 这个数据集，并把 sub-01 的解剖数据取下来
say.note: 会先 clone，再用 datalad get 取回内容

say.text: 用 datalad run 跑 bet 生成脑掩膜，并记录输入输出
say.note: 命令与结果一起提交，之后可被 rerun 重放

say.text: 先确认有没有第二份副本，再把 sub-01 的本地内容 drop 掉
say.note: 确认后释放磁盘空间，只保留指针

howto.what_en: It manages scientific datasets with DataLad and git-annex: clones OpenNeuro or DANDI datasets and fetches the real file content, records and replays analyses with datalad run/rerun, and publishes to a Git sibling plus a storage remote.
howto.when_en: Use when cloning or fetching OpenNeuro, DANDI or other DataLad datasets; when a file reads as a broken symlink or small pointer; or when an analysis needs a re-executable provenance record.

say_en.text: Clone ds000001 and get the sub-01 anatomical data
say_en.note: clones first, then datalad get fetches content

say_en.text: Run bet with datalad run and record the inputs and outputs
say_en.note: command and result are committed together, rerunnable

say_en.text: Check for a second copy, then drop the local sub-01 content
say_en.note: frees disk space after verifying, keeps the pointer
